title: Pan-Seared Sole with Browned Butter and Capers
description: A classic French dish featuring delicate sole fillets, pan-seared to perfection and served with a rich browned butter and caper sauce.
instructions: Season the sole fillets with salt and pepper.
Dredge the sole fillets in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add butter to the skillet and cook until browned, about 2 minutes.
Add the sole fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the sole fillets from the skillet and set aside.
Add capers and lemon juice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the sole fillets with the browned butter and caper sauce.
